_comment: Read by scripts/make_mesh.py, scripts/kitchen_patches.py and scripts/make_case.py. The values are the solved runs'. Metres, kelvin, watts, kilograms. x across the kitchen from the symmetry plane through the range's centre, y up from the floor, z out from the range's wall.
_solids: x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1, written as one closed STL, their union, by make_mesh.py; each box runs 0.08 m past the kitchen's faces it touches so that the castellated mesh cuts it cleanly at the walls and the symmetry plane. both: the base cabinets beside the range (x 0.38-1.84, 0.92 m high, 0.64 m deep), the wall cabinets (x 0.40-1.84, y 1.36-2.08, 0.32 m deep), the hood (x < 0.40, y 1.68-1.84, 0.48 m deep) and the range's backguard (x < 0.38, y 0.92-1.20, 0.08 m deep). shut: the range a solid block, x < 0.38 (0.76 m wide whole), 0.92 m high, 0.64 m deep. open: the range round its open cavity (x < 0.30, y 0.24-0.72, z 0.10-0.64) and the door lying flat in front of it, y 0.20-0.24, z 0.64-1.24
_cavity: the cells with centres in this box start at the oven's 435.93 K in open, and the monitor leaves them out of the kitchen's zones; z from 0 as the monitor's mask (the cells there are solid)
_pRefRequested: the pressure reference was asked at this point, which lies on cell faces; the solved runs use the nearest cell centre, (1.16, 1.72, 2.36), and the starting pressure there, 99993.93914821558 Pa, written into template/system/fvSolution
_liner: the open oven's stored heat: 6.5 kg of steel for the half oven (13 kg whole, ours, not sourced: an enamelled liner of about 1 mm and two racks) on the liner's 0.7272 m2 in two layers, its thickness the mass over rho times the meshed area, starting at 325 F (162.78 C)
_layers: 12.7 mm gypsum on the walls and the ceiling and 19 mm wood on the floor, stored in layers with an adiabatic back, starting at 293.15 K
_shutQ: W from the shut range into the half kitchen, as one even heat flux over its front and cooktop: the oven's stored heat (about 247 W whole) given out over an hour, held at its 150 s value of 237 W whole
